text:
nina: Idea: expose evidence_level on routing edits (compact|full|snapshot). default compact. tenants can opt into full/snapshot for compliance.
raj: +1. Need per-tenant byte quotas for snapshots and a pre-write estimator so we don't OOM.
frank: implementation: write compact diff sync, spawn async job to build snapshot -> store in s3, return evidence_id. webhooks reference evidence_id. keeps write latency low.
nina: console UX: Audit Settings page shows quota meter and a warning tooltip if a change will bust quota. timeline should show a tiny 'snapshot' badge when full evidence exists.
legal: require pseudonymization when tenant.pii_redaction=true. webhook events must include actor.pseudonym and actor.pseudonym_sig (HMAC with tenant key). raw emails only if tenant consents and consent recorded as audit entry.
raj: delivery/backpressure: webhook sending must respect per-tenant daily bytes limit. if exceeded, send compact fallback + metric audit.evidence.quota_exceeded. retry with exponential backoff, cap retries to avoid queue blowup.
ops-bot: deploy: audit-evidence:v1 -> staging passed smoke tests.
frank: other details: signed urls for full snapshot in NDJSON backfills. TTL configurable per tenant. chunk snapshots >5MB and store parts; evidence_id maps to part list.
nina: rollout: internal staging canary -> beta with 3 customers -> GA. document EULA key-exchange option for customers who want mapping service.
legal: add retention matrix and EU data residency note to PR. default: encrypted s3 in region, retention configurable per tenant.
raj: action items: frank write async pipeline PR, nina mock quota UI, legal draft consent flow, ops add alert rule: alert if audit.webhook.fail_rate > 0.05 over 10m.
frank: will include telemetry: audit.evidence.generate.latency, audit.evidence.bytes, audit.webhook.failures.
nina: thanks all, I'll open GH issue and pin designs to the issue. :shipit:
